latin: Demonstratio octaui Physicorum, a Aristotele ad probandum primum motorem adducta, aliquid probat speciale primo.
translation: The demonstration in the eighth book of the Physics, brought forward by Aristotle to prove a first mover, proves something particular about a first mover, not an absolutely first one.
translation_note: 'aliquid probat speciale primo' is ambiguous; rendered per the standard reading that the argument proves only a limited, not an absolutely universal, first mover (farmer1998:14139).
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch2, from Latin at farmer1998:14139
not_established: No secondary scholarship discussing thesis 12.1 specifically was found in the corpus harvest; the attribution to Moses of Egypt rests on the 900 Conclusions' own section rubric, not on external confirmation.
